'take not heed' divides across the verb and lēḇ, each holding an English word of its own, which rule 2 prefers to a fused rendering; the suffix is `unrepresented` because the recasting writes no pronoun for it.
'lest' is a rule 30 fusion of אֲשֶׁר and לֹא headed on the negative; the alternative head on the relative is named in that unit's note.
The article on had-dəḇārîm is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing 'all words' anarthrously (rule 29).
